label: Derived from explicit assertion selectors and actual source-bound JUnit; tags alone are not evidence

requirements.required_assertions: Assigned-type allocation creation: exact field/owner/count persistence, invalid input refusal, unchanged balances; W1 grants remain separate actions.
Requested allocation approval credits requester exactly once; forbidden roles/states preserve all users' balances.
Requested allocation rejection stores the actual normalized reason without changing balance; malformed approved rejection preserves pre-state.
Requested-only allocation updates/deletes; foreign-owner and owner-to-foreign target transfers are refused without mutation.
All generic/self create/update date/breakdown/attachment/assignment contexts assert exact persisted identity and effective duration.
Effective positive duration, below/at/above balances and caps, forecast reset boundaries, explicit expiry lifecycle and over-balance refusal.
All feasible BR-02 decisions plus requested/approved/pending-cancellation overlap refusal; terminal and foreign-employee exclusions; complementary halves.
Approval truth table and current-balance/policy recheck; exact debit split and unchanged approver/outsider balances; no repeated debit.
Approved rejection/cancellation refund to requester, exact available/carry split, terminal refusals, optional reason normalization and persistence.
Actual available-leave HTTP reads after allocation, consumption, refused overdraft, refund and repetition corroborate persisted assignment fields.
Independent effective-day and effective-funds boundaries, holiday context, forecast/expiry policy and current approval funds; no overdraw.
24 feasible condition combinations; all nine same-day breakdown pairs, assignment/attachment gates and meaningful overlap contexts.
Every graph state/action, four distinct actor modes and repeated allowed decisions; status and requester-versus-actor balance invariants.
All eight permission/manager/self truth rows, exact permission versus reporting-manager roles, foreign ownership and changed-target denial.
